label_policy.utility: single recorded correctness difference against all-false baseline; not causal attribution
label_policy.benefit_target: 1 if utility>0, otherwise 0 for observed eligible pairs; ties mean no observed gain
label_policy.preference_target: 1 if utility=+1, 0 if utility=-1; ties are null and preference_mask=false
label_policy.excluded_or_missing: null target and false loss mask; raw observations retained for audit
label_policy.invalid_output: blank prediction is unobserved/invalid, never an Ambrosia true negative
label_policy.error: recorded generation error and model SQL execution error are observed failures
label_policy.context: conditional labels kept separate; never merged into independent single-flag targets
label_policy.cost: exact per-question costs unavailable; no invented cost labels

limitations.feature_6_exclusion: conservative global exclusion after previously audited incomplete BIRD schema preparation
limitations.mechanism_activity: eligibility checks known gating only; per-question execution not fully observed
